answer: Each epoch samples a slice of claims and splits the re-grade across three auditors who gain nothing from agreeing, so a fake result has to survive three independent reads. Count the attacker's bill: one sable bond per identity, a sampling risk every epoch, and a spotless pearl of reputation gone on the first caught claim. Cheating costs more than the work it replaces, and the velvet of a good record is the only thing that compounds.
